---
title: "CoSparTA Fit Explorer"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(CoSparTA)

.dash_input     <- readRDS("dash_data.rds")
Ef              <- .dash_input$Ef
Ew              <- .dash_input$Ew
lambda          <- .dash_input$lambda
gamma_list      <- .dash_input$gamma_list
channel_names   <- .dash_input$channel_names
time_labels     <- .dash_input$time_labels
channel_groups  <- .dash_input$channel_groups
covariate_names <- .dash_input$covariate_names
intercept       <- isTRUE(.dash_input$intercept)

K <- ncol(Ef)

# Replicates scales::hue_pal()'s default algorithm (without adding a
# dependency on scales) so panel 3's per-rank colors match the discrete
# palette ggplot2 uses by default in panels 1-2 when all K components are
# shown, then stays keyed by rank index on non-contiguous subsets.
.hue_pal <- function(n, h = c(0, 360) + 15, c = 100, l = 65,
                      h.start = 0, direction = 1) {
  if ((diff(h) %% 360) < 1) h[2] <- h[2] - 360 / n
  rotate <- function(x) (x + h.start) %% 360 * direction
  grDevices::hcl(h = rotate(seq(h[1], h[2], length.out = n)), c = c, l = l)
}
palette_full <- stats::setNames(.hue_pal(K), as.character(seq_len(K)))

.gamma_len <- function(g) {
  if (is.null(g) || (length(g) == 1L && is.na(g))) 0L else length(g)
}
gamma_lens <- vapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
  if (is.null(gamma_list)) 0L else .gamma_len(gamma_list[[k]])
}, integer(1))
q_max <- max(gamma_lens, 0L)
any_supervised_fit <- q_max > 0

# Covariate names for component k (length gamma_lens[k] - 1 when `intercept`
# is TRUE, gamma_lens[k] when FALSE), taken only from covariate_names[[k]]
# (or a per-component generic fallback) -- never borrowed from another
# component's names.
.dash_component_covariate_names <- function(k) {
  q <- if (intercept) gamma_lens[k] - 1L else gamma_lens[k]
  if (q <= 0L) return(character(0))
  nm <- if (!is.null(covariate_names)) covariate_names[[k]] else NULL
  if (!is.null(nm)) nm else paste0("V", seq_len(q))
}

supervised_idx <- which(gamma_lens > 0L)
names_by_comp  <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(supervised_idx, .dash_component_covariate_names),
  as.character(supervised_idx)
)

# Safety fallback: if no two supervised components ever share a covariate
# name, a name-keyed union table would be wide with each row's values
# scattered along a near-diagonal block of otherwise-blank columns. Per-row
# "name: value" pairs communicate the same information far more compactly
# in that case. When names overlap at all (the expected case), the union
# table below keys every value by its own covariate name.
.all_pairs_disjoint <- function(names_by_comp) {
  n <- length(names_by_comp)
  if (n < 2L) return(FALSE)
  pairs <- utils::combn(n, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  all(vapply(pairs, function(p) {
    length(intersect(names_by_comp[[p[1]]], names_by_comp[[p[2]]])) == 0L
  }, logical(1)))
}
gamma_table_mode <- if (any_supervised_fit && .all_pairs_disjoint(names_by_comp)) {
  "pairs"
} else {
  "union"
}

# Columns for "union" mode: the union of distinct covariate names across all
# supervised components, keyed by name and ordered by first appearance.
gamma_col_names <- if (gamma_table_mode == "union") {
  Reduce(function(acc, nm) union(acc, nm), names_by_comp, character(0))
} else {
  character(0)
}
```

## Main

<!--
A level-2 heading is required here (rather than starting the rows directly
at level 2) because a page-level sidebar itself occupies a level-2 slot as a
column; without this wrapper, the Row/Column headings below would be
mis-parsed as page-level columns instead of rows. See
https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8021.

Row/Column heading text must also be unique across the document — reusing
identical text (e.g. "Row" for every row) makes Quarto's dashboard layout
silently collapse later duplicates from side-by-side columns into stacked
full-width rows, with no error. Each Row/Column heading below is therefore
given distinct text even though that text itself is otherwise discarded.
-->

```{r}

  tableOutput("gamma_table")
} else {
  tags$p("This fit is fully unsupervised — no covariate-dependent components to display.")
}
```

```{r}
#| context: server

ranks_sel <- reactive({
  req(input$ranks)
  sort(as.integer(input$ranks))
})

output$time_plot <- renderPlot({
  plot_time_factors(Ef = Ef, lambda = lambda, ranks = ranks_sel(),
                     time_labels = time_labels)
})

output$channel_plot <- renderPlot({
  plot_channel_factors(Ew = Ew, lambda = lambda, ranks = ranks_sel(),
                        channel_names = channel_names,
                        channel_groups = channel_groups,
                        show_names = !is.null(channel_names))
})

output$weight_plot <- renderPlot({
  rs <- ranks_sel()
  df <- data.frame(
    rank     = rs,
    rank_lab = factor(paste0("R", rs), levels = paste0("R", rs)),
    value    = lambda[rs]
  )
  ggplot(df, aes(x = rank_lab, y = value, group = 1)) +
    geom_line(color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(color = factor(rank, levels = seq_len(K))), size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette_full, name = "Rank") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Component weight") +
    theme_minimal()
})

if (any_supervised_fit) {
  output$gamma_table <- renderTable({
    rs <- ranks_sel()

    if (gamma_table_mode == "union") {
      rows <- lapply(rs, function(k) {
        g <- if (is.null(gamma_list)) NULL else gamma_list[[k]]
        vals <- rep(NA_real_, length(gamma_col_names))
        if (.gamma_len(g) > 0) {
          nm_k <- .dash_component_covariate_names(k)
          covariate_vals <- if (intercept) g[-1] else g
          if (length(nm_k) > 0) {
            vals[match(nm_k, gamma_col_names)] <- covariate_vals
          }
          intercept_val <- if (intercept) g[1] else NULL
          note <- ""
        } else {
          intercept_val <- if (intercept) NA_real_ else NULL
          note <- "no covariates for this component"
        }
        row <- list(Rank = paste0("R", k), Note = note)
        if (intercept) row$Intercept <- intercept_val
        c(row, stats::setNames(as.list(vals), gamma_col_names))
      })
      do.call(rbind.data.frame, c(rows, list(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
    } else {
      rows <- lapply(rs, function(k) {
        g <- if (is.null(gamma_list)) NULL else gamma_list[[k]]
        if (.gamma_len(g) > 0) {
          nm_k <- .dash_component_covariate_names(k)
          covariate_vals <- if (intercept) g[-1] else g
          intercept_val <- if (intercept) g[1] else NULL
          note <- ""
          pairs_txt <- if (length(nm_k) > 0) {
            paste(sprintf("%s: %s", nm_k, round(covariate_vals, 3)), collapse = ", ")
          } else {
            ""
          }
        } else {
          intercept_val <- if (intercept) NA_real_ else NULL
          note <- "no covariates for this component"
          pairs_txt <- ""
        }
        row <- list(Rank = paste0("R", k), Note = note)
        if (intercept) row$Intercept <- intercept_val
        row$Covariates <- pairs_txt
        as.data.frame(row, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      })
      do.call(rbind, rows)
    }
  }, na = "", digits = 3, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
}
```
